header.title: System Settings
header.tip: Dynamic configuration is stored in the database and takes precedence over appsettings.json. Leave a field empty to use the default value from the configuration file.

global.title: Global Switches
global.description: Controls overall system behavior. Changes take effect immediately.

captcha.title: Human Verification
captcha.description: reCAPTCHA v3 used by login and open-source license applications. Empty keys follow the App section of appsettings.json; changes take effect immediately without a restart.

duration.title: Grant & Retention Days
duration.description: Days for gifted service time, redeem-code validity and cleanup retention. Changes take effect immediately; the next cleanup run applies the new retention window.

pizzaHelper.title: Genshin Pizza Helper
pizzaHelper.description: Upstream salts and endpoints for Spiral Abyss data sync, maintained entirely here. Empty fields no longer fall back to appsettings.json.

afdian.title: Afdian Orders
afdian.description: Order verification credentials and product IDs, maintained entirely here. Empty fields no longer fall back to appsettings.json.

yae.title: Yae Achievement Metadata
yae.description: Bucket URLs used to pull the Yae version table (protobuf) and the CN client executable fingerprints, maintained entirely here. Separate multiple values with commas, semicolons, or newlines; empty values use the built-in defaults.

sso.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
sso.description: External OIDC identity provider, maintained entirely here. Empty fields no longer fall back to appsettings.json; changes take effect immediately without a restart.

killSwitch.title: Feature Kill Switches
killSwitch.description: Emergency-disable injection features on clients, delivered via /Patch/hutao and applied on next client launch; turning a switch off restores user-local settings.

s3Sign.title: Update Package S3 Presigned URLs
s3Sign.description: When a mirror URL matches this host name, /Patch/hutao issues a time-limited presigned URL on the fly before delivery, so the bucket can stay private. Leave empty to disable.

maintenanceMode.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenanceMode.hint: When enabled, all non-admin endpoints return a maintenance response

registrationEnabled.label: Allow Registration
registrationEnabled.hint: When disabled, new users cannot register passport accounts

captchaEnabled.label: Enable Captcha
captchaEnabled.hint: When disabled, login no longer verifies reCAPTCHA; leaving either the site key or the secret key empty also disables it

recaptchaSiteKey.label: Site Key
recaptchaSiteKey.hint: reCAPTCHA v3 site key, embedded in the login page and the built-in verification page; publicly visible

recaptchaSecretKey.label: Secret Key
recaptchaSecretKey.hint: Server-side credential only; shown as ********. Leave it empty or keep ******** to keep the saved value, use Reset to clear it

recaptchaMinScore.label: Minimum Score
recaptchaMinScore.hint: 0-1. Verification fails when the Google confidence score is below this value; default 0.5

skuGachaLog.label: Wish Log SKU
skuGachaLog.hint: SKU ID of the wish log service in Afdian orders

skuCdn.label: CDN Service SKU
skuCdn.hint: SKU ID of the CDN service in Afdian 2 orders

afdianUserId.label: Afdian User ID
afdianUserId.hint: Afdian user ID used for order verification (query-order)

afdianUserToken.label: Afdian Token
afdianUserToken.hint: Afdian open API token used for order verification; leave blank to keep the current value

afdian2UserId.label: Afdian2 User ID
afdian2UserId.hint: Afdian user ID used for CDN order verification

afdian2UserToken.label: Afdian2 Token
afdian2UserToken.hint: Afdian open API token used for CDN order verification; leave blank to keep the current value

yaeBucketUrls.label: Bucket URLs
yaeBucketUrls.hint: Tried in order, separated by commas, semicolons, or newlines; leave blank to use the built-in defaults

yaeChineseGameHashes.label: CN Executable Fingerprints
yaeChineseGameHashes.hint: Decimal CRC32 of the first 64 KiB of YuanShen.exe, separated by commas; leave blank to use the built-in default

registrationGiftDays.label: Registration Gift Days
registrationGiftDays.hint: Days of Hutao Cloud access granted to a brand new account on first registration; 1-365, default 3

gachaLogExtendDays.label: Abyss Upload Gift Days
gachaLogExtendDays.hint: Days added to the gacha log service of the bound passport account when a Spiral Abyss record is uploaded; 1-365, default 3

redeemCodeExpireDays.label: Redeem Code Valid Days
redeemCodeExpireDays.hint: Validity of redeem codes generated for unregistered users; 1-365, default 3. The day count in the delivery email follows this value

jobLogRetentionDays.label: Job Log Retention Days
jobLogRetentionDays.hint: How long scheduled job execution logs are kept; 7-3650, default 90

spiralAbyssRecordRetentionDays.label: Spiral Abyss Record Retention Days
spiralAbyssRecordRetentionDays.hint: How long uploaded Spiral Abyss records and their rankings are kept; 7-3650, default 30. Older records are deleted together with the rankings

diagnosticEmail.label: Diagnostic Email
diagnosticEmail.hint: Email address that receives system exception and order diagnostic notifications

sso.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
sso.description: External OIDC identity provider. Changes take effect immediately without a restart.

ssoEnabled.label: Enable SSO
ssoEnabled.hint: When off, the admin falls back to maintainer login and no write gate is enforced

ssoAuthority.label: Authority
ssoAuthority.hint: Issuer address, must serve /.well-known/openid-configuration; Auto-fill verifies it against the discovery document and backfills what it can

ssoClientId.label: Client ID
ssoClientId.hint: The client ID registered at the identity provider

ssoClientSecret.label: Client Secret
ssoClientSecret.hint: Confidential credential, server-side only; keep it in sync with the identity provider

ssoRedirectUri.label: Admin redirect URI
ssoRedirectUri.hint: Must match the registration exactly, e.g. https://api.example.com/Admin/Sso/Callback

ssoClientRedirectUri.label: Launcher redirect URI
ssoClientRedirectUri.hint: Redirect URI for client-side SSO, a different address from the admin one; the launcher no longer offers SSO sign-in, so this can stay empty

ssoDisplayName.label: Display name
ssoDisplayName.hint: Provider name shown on the login button; falls back to frontend copy when empty

ssoBootstrapClaim.label: Bootstrap claim
ssoBootstrapClaim.hint: Claim name for the first admin account, e.g. sub / preferred_username / email

ssoBootstrapValue.label: Bootstrap value
ssoBootstrapValue.hint: The first login whose claim matches this value provisions the seed account

ssoRequireHttps.label: Require HTTPS
ssoRequireHttps.hint: Keep enabled in production; only disable for local http testing

disableFpsUnlock.label: Disable FPS unlock
disableFpsUnlock.hint: Force the FPS unlock off for all clients in the current session

disableFpsUnlockReason.label: FPS unlock reason
disableFpsUnlockReason.hint: Shown to clients while disabled; leave empty for the default hint

disableIslandInjection.label: Disable Island injection
disableIslandInjection.hint: Force Island injection off for all clients in the current session

disableIslandInjectionReason.label: Island injection reason
disableIslandInjectionReason.hint: Shown to clients while disabled; leave empty for the default hint

form.emptyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default

messages.discoverInvalid: The authority must be a full URL starting with http:// or https://
messages.discoverTimeout: Timed out reading the discovery document: {url}
messages.discoverNetworkFail: Unable to read {url}; the provider probably does not allow cross-origin requests from this admin origin
messages.discoverBadJson: The discovery document is not valid JSON: {url}
messages.discoverIssuerMissing: The discovery document has no issuer
messages.discoverIssuerMismatch: The discovery issuer is {actual} while you entered {expected}; the server rejects this metadata too, so fill in the issuer
messages.discoverNoChange: Discovery verified; the configuration already matches
